FILE: ibm-2315-cartridge.jpg

TITLE: Disk Cartridge 2315 type
DESCRIPTION: Removable disk cartridge used in an IBM 1130, compatible with
             IBM 2315 type, made by Nashua Corp.
AUTHOR: James Berlin
DATE: 4 October 2011
SOURCE: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Disk_Cartridge_2315_type.jb.jpg
LICENSE: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)
LICENSE URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

MODIFICATIONS: Scaled down from original 2,345 × 1,653 pixels to 960 × 677
               pixels for web display purposes.

"Disk Cartridge 2315 type" by James Berlin is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.

FILE: ibm-1130-console.jpg

TITLE: IBM 1130 Console at Computer History Museum
DESCRIPTION: IBM 1130 computer system console showing the 1131 CPU unit with
             keyboard, console typewriter, and control panel. The console desk
             housed the central processing unit and operator interface.
AUTHOR: ArnoldReinhold
DATE: 26 February 2012
SOURCE: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IBM_1130_console_at_CHM.agr.JPG
LICENSE: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)

MODIFICATIONS: None

"IBM 1130 console at CHM.agr" by ArnoldReinhold is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
